integrity: The all-parameter proof is combinatorial and uses uniform surjections plus exact pair-collision counts. Finite exact enumeration is supplementary rather than a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact formulas assume an equiprobable multinomial null and sampling zeros.
The result does not cover unequal cell probabilities, fitted expected probabilities, fixed-margin contingency tables, or structural zeros.
The complete text of the 1970 Good-Gover-Mitchell exact-distribution article was not available for direct comparison.
title: Exact Pearson moments conditional on the number of empty multinomial cells
